description: Layered map of collateral and wrapper dependencies between stablecoins. Band width shows each dependent's supply mapped to its upstream; select a hub to see what sits downstream.
title: Dependency Map
lead: See hidden systemic risk: the live graph of who backs whom.
headerSupplement: This map lays out direct collateral and wrapper dependencies between stablecoins from upstream to downstream. Select a hub to light its mapped dependents, or switch to the Network view to inspect individual coins.

lens.graph: The graph shows direct collateral and wrapper links between stablecoins. The shared failure domains board lists published shared control or custody identities without drawing them as separate graph nodes.

lens.scope: Band width is a dependent's supply at publication evaluation mapped to its upstream; in the Network view node size reflects market cap. Neither is a forecast of losses. A dependency link identifies a relationship, not an outcome.

faq.question: What does the Dependency Map show?
faq.answer: The Dependency Map shows direct collateral and wrapper dependencies between stablecoins with published Safety Scores, laid out in layers from coins that depend on no tracked coin to their furthest dependents. Bridges, custodians, and other shared infrastructure are not drawn as separate nodes.

faq.question: Why can dependency risk matter even when a coin holds its peg?
faq.answer: An upstream collateral asset, bridge, issuer, or shared contract can transmit changes to a dependent coin before a price depeg appears. Exposure mode traces mapped relationships, not the outcome of a failure.

faq.question: How should I combine this with Safety Scores?
faq.answer: Use the map to trace collateral and wrapper relationships, then read each coin's grade and dependency inputs on Safety Scores.

exposure.description: Find coins linked to these upstream assets through mapped collateral and wrapper relationships. This does not estimate losses or changes in Safety Scores.
